name: combat-4: a physical strike reads weapon weakness (44 R6, second half), on today's weakness table
why: 44-formula-architecture section 5.1 judges that a cast with no element reads the weapon weakness of its caster. 52-review-combat found the table is lopsided: hammer 68 of 190, sword 44, axe 0. This plays R6's weakness half on the table as it stands, to see which melee way it lifts. It targets pace.

edits.from: const dmg = () => roll(sc, hitRange(blowOf(u, row), row));
edits.to: const dmg = (m) => { const hh = inst.heroes && inst.heroes[u.id]; const vs = !el && m && m.side === 'mon' && hh && typeof hh.rollsVs === 'function' ? hh.rollsVs(rowOf(inst, m.kind), m.kind) : null; const wk = vs && vs.weak && vs.weak.matched ? 1.2 : 1; return roll(sc, hitRange(Math.max(1, Math.floor((Number(blowOf(u, row)) || 1) * wk)), row)); };

edits.from: const r = landHit(inst, sc, u, m, dmg(), el, hitTag, sg);
edits.to: const r = landHit(inst, sc, u, m, dmg(m), el, hitTag, sg);
